_comment: What each module that calls straight into the Horizon runtime shares with it:
the headers that lay out its syscalls or unix calls. The DLL pack's manifest
gives such a module the feature iface:<module>:<hash>, the first 12 hex digits of
the sha256 of these files in order; a runtime built from the same files reports
the same, so a card never pairs one with a runtime built against other headers.
Being in a static unix-call table (dlls/ntdll/unix/virtual.c) is a feature of its
own, unixlib:<name> (native) or unixlib32:<name> (WoW64), read from the table.
